subject: Change default pidfile from redis.pid to valkey.pid (#378)
reason: The change only renames the default pidfile path constant used when the server is daemonized with no pidfile configured, plus test-asset configs and a comment. The pidfile config still defaults to empty, so CONFIG GET pidfile and every command reply are identical on both builds; the default path is only ever used under daemonize with root-writable /var/run, which the fuzzer's non-daemonized throwaway servers never exercise. No observable behaviour reachable by any experiment changes, so no scenario is needed.
